title: Open Workshop Flyer
description: A two-sided event flyer for a carpentry workshop that doubles as a recruiting touchpoint.

thumbnail.alt: Flyer front: 'Tag der offenen Werkstatt.' on linen

body: The front sells the event in three seconds: what, when, where. The back carries the programme – and closes with the recruiting message, linked to the online application funnel.
Same visual language as the recruiting ads and landing page, so every touchpoint feels like one brand.
